findings: Stale misleading comment in displayBoard — 'no breakdown available in displayBoard, ties may remain' is false; breakdown is fully built and tie-breaking resolves correctly. Remove or correct the comment.

CSV criterion average values not sanitised — critCols passes bd.avg through q() without sanitizeText. Server-computed so no immediate injection risk, but inconsistent with all other user-derived columns. Apply sanitizeText or document the exemption.

judgeName unescaped in fetch-rendered HTML — the inline polling script concatenates j.judgeName directly into innerHTML without HTML escaping. Currently limited to admin-controlled data; becomes a stored XSS path if judge-name editing or self-registration is added. HTML-escape before injection.
No test coverage for unresolvable-tie path — applyTieBreaking has no automated tests; the tieBroken: false code path could silently break under refactor.
